scope: Create an unsent institutional D1_rights briefing, unselected decision register and evidence locators; preserve all prior documents and packets, assume no approvals and contact no one.
negative_control_method: Read-only validator accepted the unfilled preparation object and rejected eight separately altered in-memory copies: institutional/coauthor approval, contacts made, sent, recipient, selected disposition, reviewer name and automatic adoption. No altered copy was saved; no live contact or approval occurred.

preservation.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 concatenation of case-sensitive PowerShell-sorted absolute_full_path<TAB>length<TAB>uppercase_file_SHA256<LF> records; hidden files included. Source contents hashed without parsing participant values.
preservation.source_identity: Nine repository sources and four restricted originals were individually fingerprint-checked against evidence_manifest.json. Restricted originals were neither copied nor edited.
preservation.scope_limit: All existing tracked files and the complete prior audit-local tree were hashed; only four selected external restricted originals were individually checked. Other protected folders, cloud access settings, raw participant records, mailbox exports and historical/current public exposure were not comprehensively audited.

unchanged_formal_records: All existing workflow state and gate records
Historical consent account, checklist, preparation audit and acceptance records
review_method: Same-agent second-pass evidence/decision/authority review plus explicit structural checks and file-set preservation. No independent institutional, legal or coauthor review is claimed.

proposed_commit.title: docs: prepare institutional D1_rights review packet
description: Add an unsent institutional briefing, 12 unselected decision records and 16 evidence entries.
Separate historical ethics review, consent coverage and scope, data stewardship, privacy history, derivative disclosure, access/licensing and coauthor/funder checkpoints.
Preserve the accepted historical account and distinguish one author's documentary acceptance from institutional or coauthor approval.
Pin accessible evidence, retain explicit limits on prior mailbox observations and author testimony, and leave reviewer/decision fields unfilled.
Audit all 1,227 existing tracked files and 23,281 prior audit-local files without modifying them.
No contacts, participant processing, fitting, source replacement, Git/cloud mutation, submission or public release.

completion_boundary: Preparation and technical audit only. Competent reviewers, actual institutional determinations, supporting evidence retrieval, any separately authorized participant/disclosure checks, coauthor/funder approvals and submission/release remain outstanding.
